notes: Vanilla Arms at 60: Rend and Mortal Strike are the priority openers, Overpower is a bare cast so it only lands when the dodge-triggered aura from sim/warrior/overpower.go is up, and Heroic Strike is the rage dump. Arms has no Death Wish (that talent lives in the Fury tree only), so Recklessness is the burst cooldown instead. The fork's warrior/apls/dps_no_reck.apl.json preset is actually Bloodthirst-based (a Fury list despite the generic name); there is no Arms-specific preset upstream, so this is adapted from it plus the community rotation order (Rend upkeep, Mortal Strike on cooldown, Overpower as a filler, Heroic Strike/Cleave spam). The first cited guide is Icy Veins' own WoW Classic (Era, not TBC) DPS Warrior guide, whose priority list matches this file's order exactly. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/ -- Overpower and Mortal Strike each carry an extra low rank in this build that vanilla did not have, so the highest-numbered rank, not the highest rank number remembered from live Classic, is what is named. Nothing here is Forever-specific yet: the validation job (design section 6) is the evidence for changing it.

priorityList.notes: Bloodrage on cooldown: rage is the limiting resource, same as Fury.
Recklessness on cooldown: Arms has no Death Wish, so this is the burst cooldown.
Keep Rend up: Improved Rend and Deep Wounds both want the bleed ticking.
Mortal Strike is the highest damage per rage button and comes off a six second cooldown.
Overpower is a bare cast: the engine's ExtraCastCondition only lets it land while the dodge-triggered proc aura is up, so it is a free line that falls through otherwise.
Heroic Strike as the rage dump, never below 40 rage.
